verdict.rationale: llamafile has a documented command-line arguments reference, runs models from the command line, bundles configurable default arguments, and ships GPU acceleration, so CLI-configured model loading is plausibly supported. However, no evidence names specific GPU-offload or context-length flags. One community user could not shift processing to the GPU, which shows offload control is undocumented here but is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documented GPU layer-offload flag, documented context-length flag, a worked command-line example combining them, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line

citations.quote: llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, and Vulkan.
A llamafile bundles the llamafile executable, model weights, and a set of default arguments into a single self-contained file
If you add the `--cli` argument to a llamafile, you will run a CLI version of the model that answers to whatever you provide as a prompt
